searches.reason: Develop a calibrated diagnostic test suite connecting failures to NextItNet components. Use controlled faults in causality, dilation, left padding and final-position readout to measure probe detection rates and false alarms. Compare activation interventions with matched controls on the same trained network; distinguish in-memory consistency from predictor reload parity, which remains unavailable without a host interface.

searches.reason: Turn qualitative feedback into auditable recommendation-level evidence. Seek annotation protocols linking actual recommendations and explicit feedback to unsupported requirements, incompatibility, satisfied needs and precise preference matches, using only supplied histories, titles, descriptions and timestamps. Measure preferred-versus-rejected rank ordering, annotation agreement and assessability coverage; retain unknown judgments separately and avoid inferring unobserved needs or traits.

searches.reason: Replace unrestricted history perturbations with support-aware tests of temporal dependence. Investigate matched history replacements and conditional permutations that control item frequency, lexical similarity, repetition and prefix length. Measure perturbation support and distance-specific rank changes to separate order sensitivity from distribution shift and broad-interest shortcuts. Keep these training-only diagnostics distinct from pinned validation HR@10 and reuse one trained NextItNet per category.
